“We have to build up the character of our future generation which means the highest sense of honour, integrity, selfless service to the nation, and a sense of responsibility, and we have to ensure that they are highly qualified or fully equipped to play their role in various fields of life in a manner that may bring honour to Pakistan.”
Quaid-e-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah
27 November 1947
The world of today is the world of technology; a key factor to achieve not only progress and success but excellence in every field of life. The new century demands some serious thinking, bold initiatives and result-oriented actions to keep pace with the developed countries of the world.
Departments newly introduced take a fairly long time before they are established and recognized for academic achievements. We have been vigorously pursuing our dream of achieving a high standard of academic excellence and quality education by providing highly qualified and trained faculty, well equipped and established labs and challenging curriculum. Our belief is in quality; therefore, we have high expectations of our students and graduates. Now, it is your turn to leave no stone unturned to work hard, prove your worth and promote the name of your Alma Mater.
